entries.source:
Gorath seemed distant.
	Though the moredhel warrior didn't appear grieved about killing the assassin that had followed them from the Northlands, his eyes had a baleful look in them that seemed something between hatred and rage. Several times he glanced back at the corpse that lay behind them in the dust, his thoughts unguessable from his expression...�
entries.translation:
戈拉斯顯得心不在焉。
	雖然這名莫瑞德戰士對殺死那名一路從北地跟蹤而來的刺客似乎並不悲傷，但他眼中閃著一絲介於憎恨與盛怒之間的凶光。他好幾次回頭望向那具倒在塵土中的屍體，神情難以揣測……�

entries.source: Do you wish to bury him? We could do that.�
entries.translation: 你想把他埋了嗎？我們可以幫忙。�

entries.source:
It is not our way. I simply am somewhat disturbed that he should come after me. He was...a ókinsman. There are other things that trouble me as well...
	Delekhan's assistants are slow but not altogether stupid. Another like Haseth and you'll only have my ócorpse to drag before your Prince Arutha.�
entries.translation:
這不是我們的作風。只是他竟會來追殺我，讓我有些不安。他曾是……我的ó族人。還有其他事也讓我心煩……
	迪勒肯的手下雖然遲鈍，卻不算愚蠢。再來一個哈賽斯這樣的人，你能帶去見亞魯莎王子的，就只剩我的ó屍體了。�

entries.source:
Sorry, you don't get off that easy. As long as you are under my command you are forbidden to die, moredhel. I've gone to far too much trouble keeping you alive to bury you now.
	It's time that we took the chains off of you. It'll be far easier for you to defend yourself if your hands are free to swing a sword again.�
entries.translation:
抱歉，沒那麼容易脫身。只要你還歸我管，就不准死，莫瑞德人。我費了這麼大功夫才讓你活到現在，可不是為了現在把你埋了。
	也該幫你解開鎖鏈了。雙手能自由揮劍，你護身也會容易得多。�

entries.source: You're not just going to set him free are you? I thought you said he was your prisoner.�
entries.translation: 你該不會真要放他自由吧？你不是說他是你的俘虜嗎？�

entries.source: He is my prisoner, Owyn, but the circumstances are terribly complicated. Even if he chose to sneak off, he'd be lucky to make it to the next town alive. This is the third such assassin we've run into since we left the Northlands and I have a feeling that more will be waiting for us. He will be much safer with me and I with him.�
entries.translation: 他是我的俘虜沒錯，歐文，但情況複雜得很。就算他想趁機開溜，能不能活著走到下一座城鎮都難說。這已經是我們離開北地後遇上的第三名刺客了，我有預感後面還會有更多。跟著我，他會更安全；有他在，我也一樣。�

entries.source: As the boy would be. If he were to whisper the wrong word in the wrong ear, he could easily be the death of us.�
entries.translation: 這小子也是。他只要在錯的人耳邊說錯一句話，就能輕易害死我們所有人。�

entries.source: Me? Who am I going to talk to? I'm not even heading in the same direction.�
entries.translation: 我？我能跟誰說？我根本不跟你們同路。�

entries.source:
It wouldn't be a matter of who you talked to, Owyn. There will be ears listening for word of a moredhel travelling with a noble. Damnation. I should have thought about this when you entered camp...
	For the time being, you're my squire. Once we arrive safely at the palace, you'll be free to go your own way.�
entries.translation:
問題不在你跟誰說，歐文。到處都有耳朵在打探『貴族帶著莫瑞德人同行』的消息。該死，你一進營地我就該想到這點……
	現在起，你暫時算我的侍從。等我們平安抵達王宮，你想去哪就去哪。�

entries.source: But I have pressing business in Tiburn...�
entries.translation: 可是我在提伯恩還有要緊事……�

entries.source: This is not a subject of debate! óWe ómust óget óto óKrondor. My mission is of critical importance and I don't have time to improvise an easy solution. The only other possible option would be to slit your throat and leave you dying. I have absolutely no desire to do that. Now let's get moving before Delekhan's assassins catch our scent again. They'll likely come looking when Haseth doesn't return from his mission.�
entries.translation: 這沒有商量的餘地！ó我們ó必須ó立刻ó趕到ó克朗多。我的任務至關重大，沒時間慢慢想辦法。唯一的替代方案，就是割開你的喉嚨，讓你留在這裡等死，但我完全不想那麼做。現在該上路了，免得迪勒肯的刺客又循著氣味追上來——等哈賽斯遲遲沒能歸隊覆命，他們大概很快就會出來找人。�

entries.source: ...Gorath leapt forward, his chains writhing between his wrists like metallic vipers.�
entries.translation: ……戈拉斯猛然向前撲去，鎖鏈在他腕間如金屬毒蛇般扭動。�

entries.source:
#Gorath#
	Get out from underfoot, Owyn! Assassin in the camp!�
entries.translation:
#戈拉斯#
	歐文，別擋路！營地裡有刺客！�
entries.notes: Phase 6 pipeline live-verification test (chapter-1 ambush trigger node).

entries.source:
#Gorath#
	Do not struggle so, Haseth. I wish to keep you alive.�
entries.translation:
#戈拉斯#
	別掙扎了，哈賽斯。我還想留你活口。�

entries.source:
#Gorath#
	But be glad I do ónot. The goddess of death will show you greater mercy.�
entries.translation:
#戈拉斯#
	但你該慶幸我ó不想。死亡女神會待你更加仁慈。�

entries.source:
#Arutha#
	As glad as I am at the sight of you safely home again, Locklear, I can't say that my nose is as well pleased. I thought we had broken you and Seigneur James of clambering round in the sewers.�
entries.translation:
#亞魯莎#
	洛克利爾，看你平安歸來我固然高興，但我的鼻子可不這麼認為。我還以為早就治好你跟詹姆士紳爵鑽下水道的毛病了。�

entries.source:
#Locklear#
	You know the way of old habits, highness. We encountered a bit of trouble with the gates and so I chose a more expedient though somewhat more disagreeable path. It came to a happy end, however. James told us to send word that he is well and would see you in the morning.�
entries.translation:
#洛克利爾#
	殿下也知道，舊習難改。我們在城門遇上了點麻煩，我便選了條比較快、但沒那麼好聞的路。不過結果還算圓滿。詹姆士要我們捎個話，說他一切安好，明早就來見您。�

entries.source:
#Arutha#
	Incurable sewer rats, the both of you. I shall have to order that each of you be accompanied by a score of washing maidens to keep you presentable enough for court. Welcome home, Locky.�
entries.translation:
#亞魯莎#
	你們兩個真是無藥可救的下水道老鼠。看來我得下令，派二十個女侍伺候你們梳洗，才能讓你們有臉面出席朝廷。歡迎回家，洛克。�

entries.source:
#Locklear#
	Thank you. As happy as I am to be here, I'm afraid I come with bad news from the Northlands.�
entries.translation:
#洛克利爾#
	多謝。雖然很高興回到這裡，但恐怕我帶回的，是北地傳來的壞消息。�

entries.source:
#Arutha#
	I expected as much. With the false Nighthawks prowling my streets above and below it can only mean the moredhel are up to their old mischief. What do you know?�
entries.translation:
#亞魯莎#
	我早有預感。冒牌夜鷹會在我的街道上下橫行，除了莫瑞德人又在耍老把戲，還能有什麼解釋。你知道些什麼？�

entries.source: Motioning to Gorath, Locklear introduced the former moredhel chieftain with a wave. Slowly, Gorath lowered his hood. The gasps and startled reactions of those crowding the hall helped mask the stealthy entrance of a second moredhel in the chamber; this one armed with a longbow!�
entries.translation: 洛克利爾朝戈拉斯一揮手，介紹這位前莫瑞德酋長。戈拉斯緩緩放下兜帽。大廳裡擠滿的人群一陣倒抽冷氣、驚呼四起，卻也掩護了另一名莫瑞德人悄悄潛入殿內——這人手持長弓！�

entries.source:
#Pug#
óAssassin! óGet ódown!�
entries.translation:
#帕格#
ó刺客！ó快ó趴下！�

entries.source:
#Arutha#
	What I must or must not do will not be dictated by a dissident moredhel! If not for Locklear's good faith in you, I would have had your head staked on a pole and paraded up and down the low quarters of Krondor once I saw you!�
entries.translation:
#亞魯莎#
	我該做什麼、不該做什麼，輪不到一個叛逃的莫瑞德人來指使！要不是看在洛克利爾信任你的份上，我一見到你，就會把你的頭插在竿子上，遊街示眾走遍克朗多的貧民區！�

entries.source:
#Gorath#
	What evidence? I bear the humiliation of betraying my vow as a moredhel and the indignity of surrendering to a sworn enemy...�
entries.translation:
#戈拉斯#
	什麼證據？我背負著違背莫瑞德誓言的恥辱，也承受著向宿敵俯首投降的屈辱……�

entries.source:
#Makala#
	Why betray Delekhan to the Kingdom of the Isles? Of what benefit to you is it to snare him?�
entries.translation:
#馬卡拉#
	你為何要向島嶼王國出賣迪勒肯？誘他落網，對你有什麼好處？�

entries.source:
#Gorath#
	He is leader in name only. However bitter a draught Delekhan may be for your kith and kin to drink, magician, his rule is black poison in the gullets of me and mine. Already he enslaves my cousins and rapes the land.�
entries.translation:
#戈拉斯#
	他不過是有名無實的首領。法師，迪勒肯這杯苦酒，對你們的族人而言或許難以下嚥，但對我和我的族人來說，他的統治就是灌入喉頭的黑毒。他已經奴役了我的族親，蹂躪著這片土地。�

entries.source:
#Arutha#
	Where would you have me send my troops? If indeed he intends a strike against one of our northernmost possessions, which castle shall I garrison for the attack? Highcastle? Ironpass? Northwarden? If I am to fight a war, by my teeth tell me where would you have me fight it!�
entries.translation:
#亞魯莎#
	你要我把軍隊派去哪裡？如果他真打算進攻我們最北的領地，我該派兵駐守哪座城堡迎敵？高堡？鐵山口？北衛城？如果要打這場仗，看在老天份上，告訴我該在哪裡開戰！�

entries.source:
#Gorath#
	Would that I could tell you! Delekhan holds in good confidence only a handful of cowering dogs and, among them, only a few are privy to his war plans. His private councils are restricted to choice individuals, his advisers Narab and Nago, his mistress Liallan, his son Moraeulf and---Nighthawks!�
entries.translation:
#戈拉斯#
	我倒希望我能告訴你！迪勒肯真正信任的，只有寥寥幾條卑躬屈膝的走狗，而其中知曉他戰略的更是少之又少。他的密議只容許少數幾人參與：他的謀士納拉布與納戈、他的情婦莉艾蘭、他的兒子莫萊伍夫，還有——夜鷹會！�

entries.source:
#Arutha#
	He keeps foul company that leader of yours...�
entries.translation:
#亞魯莎#
	你們那位首領，交的可真是些惡友……�

entries.source:
#Gorath#
	Your highness, if you give me leave, I believe I can find the evidence of Delekhan's intent. I will need someone to accompany me to Romney and supplies for my journey and a small parcel of gold.�
entries.translation:
#戈拉斯#
	殿下，若您應允，我相信我能找到迪勒肯圖謀的證據。我需要一人與我同行前往羅姆尼，並備妥旅途所需的補給與少許黃金。�

entries.source:
#Arutha#
	Romney? What do you think you can find in a provincial river town in the heart of the Kingdom?�
entries.translation:
#亞魯莎#
	羅姆尼？你認為在王國腹地一座偏遠的河畔小鎮，能找到什麼？�

entries.source:
#Gorath#
	I aim to catch a bird in flight. Of late Delekhan has emptied a good deal of his treasury to revive the service of the Nighthawks. In exchange he has demanded tactical information about Kingdom holdings...�
entries.translation:
#戈拉斯#
	我打算趁鳥兒振翅時將牠擒下。近來迪勒肯大量耗費國庫，重金聘回夜鷹會為他效力。作為交換，他要求對方提供王國領地的戰略情報……�

entries.source:
#Pug#
	He's turned the Guild of Assassins into a guild of spies?�
entries.translation:
#帕格#
	他把刺客公會變成了間諜公會？�

entries.source:
#Gorath#
	Only for a time. Although the payments have been left in various hidden locales, the messengers were always sent to a rendezvous in Romney. If I go there, I may be able to intercept information concerning a forthcoming attack. Would such evidence suffice?�
entries.translation:
#戈拉斯#
	暫時而已。雖然酬金都藏在各處隱密的地點，但信使總會被派到羅姆尼會合。若我前往那裡，或許能攔截到即將發動攻擊的情報。這樣的證據，足夠了嗎？�

entries.source:
#Arutha#
	Perhaps.
	Damn me but I don't trust you Gorath. How do I know that this isn't a plot of yours? We can weigh the evidence to our hearts content and your cousins could be slitting the throats of my serfs as we sit dawdling...�
entries.translation:
#亞魯莎#
	或許吧。
	但老實說，戈拉斯，我不信任你。我怎麼知道這不是你自己的陰謀？我們大可慢慢琢磨證據，但說不定就在我們議而不決的時候，你的族人正在割開我子民的喉嚨……�

entries.source:
#Arutha#
	I have been tolerant while I listened to your vague speculations based on incidental half-heard conversations, but how am I to believe what you say? What evidence have you laid before this council to prove what Delekhan intends to do?�
entries.translation:
#亞魯莎#
	我已經很有耐心地聽你根據偷聽來的隻言片語做出種種含糊的臆測，但我要如何相信你說的話？你在這場議事上，究竟拿出了什麼證據，能證明迪勒肯的意圖？�

entries.source:
#Gorath#
	Bloody his nose, Prince of Krondor. Blunt his swords and the unified tribes will cast him down in wrath. Let him cross your Northern border, however, and ten other clans will join their strength to his and the legacy of Murmandamus will be but a spark next to his glory.�
entries.translation:
#戈拉斯#
	打得他鼻青臉腫吧，克朗多王子。挫敗他的鋒芒，聯合部族便會憤而將他推翻。但若讓他越過你們的北疆一步，另外十個氏族就會與他合流，屆時穆爾曼達穆斯的遺業，比起他的榮光也不過是星星之火。�

entries.source:
#Arutha#
	Go to Romney, but you will provide for yourself. If this is part of some secret moredhel scheme, I'll not look the fool before the world. Pug, unroll the map for me...�
entries.translation:
#亞魯莎#
	去羅姆尼吧，但一切開銷自理。若這是莫瑞德人某種陰謀的一環，我可不想在世人面前扮成傻瓜。帕格，替我把地圖攤開……�

entries.source:
#Arutha#
	As I see it, Delekhan could have only two potential targets for attack into the Kingdom: óHighcastle...�
entries.translation:
#亞魯莎#
	依我看，迪勒肯若要進犯王國，可能的目標只有兩處：ó高堡……�

entries.source:
#Arutha#
	...and óNorthwarden.�
entries.translation:
#亞魯莎#
	……以及ó北衛城。�

entries.source:
#Arutha#
	His fortress at óSar-Sargoth is three hundred miles to the North and I doubt he has the resources to defend a line that long.�
entries.translation:
#亞魯莎#
	他位於ó薩薩戈斯的要塞，遠在三百哩之外的北方，我懷疑他沒有足夠的資源，能守住這麼長的防線。�

entries.source:
#Arutha#
	So an attack at Northwarden seems unlikely.�
entries.translation:
#亞魯莎#
	所以進攻北衛城的可能性似乎不高。�

entries.source:
#Pug#
	Leaving óHighcastle...�
entries.translation:
#帕格#
	那就只剩下ó高堡了……�

entries.source:
#Arutha#
	Which is a viable alternative, but neither target seems to have an obvious goal. I know you are no field strategist and you hate to become involved in state matters but I should like you to delay your return to your home at Stardock for a while. I feel...ill at ease.�
entries.translation:
#亞魯莎#
	這確實是個可行的選項，但兩個目標似乎都沒有明顯的戰略價值。我知道你不擅長行軍布陣，也不喜歡插手國事，但我希望你暫緩返回星塢島。我總覺得……有些不安。�

entries.source:
#Pug#
	You are not alone in that. I too have sensed something unusual in the air, but I won't ascribe it to anything as dire as magic. More likely we suffer from bad soup.�
entries.translation:
#帕格#
	你不是唯一有這種感覺的人。我也察覺到空氣中有些異樣，但我不會把它歸咎於什麼可怕的魔法。更可能只是湯喝壞了肚子。�

entries.source:
#Arutha#
	Feelings aside, I will call up the militia reserves from óMalac's óCross, óDarkmoor, and óLyton and join them to a detachment of the Krondorian Lancers just outside of the Dimwood.�
entries.translation:
#亞魯莎#
	先不論預感，我會徵召ó馬拉克ó十字鎮、ó黑沼鎮ó與萊頓的民兵預備隊，會同幽暗林外一支克朗多槍騎兵分隊。�

entries.source:
#Arutha#
James will send word to me there.�
entries.translation:
#亞魯莎#
詹姆士會派人到那裡向我通報。�

entries.source:
#Pug#
	What of the garrison?�
entries.translation:
#帕格#
	那守軍呢？�

entries.source:
#Arutha#
	It will remain in place. I have considered the option of a full push south and it seems unlikely, but I will give Delekhan nothing. Our agreement remains.�
entries.translation:
#亞魯莎#
	守軍原地不動。我考慮過全面南撤的可能，但機率不大——不過我也不會讓迪勒肯佔到任何便宜。我們的約定依舊算數。�

entries.source:
#Arutha#
	Now we wait. Gods help Gorath if he betrays us to the moredhel.�
entries.translation:
#亞魯莎#
	現在只能等了。戈拉斯若敢出賣我們給莫瑞德人，就求老天保佑他吧。�

entries.source:
#Arutha#
	As I see it, Delekhan could have only two potential targets for attack into the Kingdom: óHighcastle...�
entries.translation:
#亞魯莎#
	依我看，迪勒肯若要進犯王國，可能的目標只有兩處：ó高堡……�

entries.source:
#Arutha#
	...and óNorthwarden.�
entries.translation:
#亞魯莎#
	……以及ó北衛城。�

entries.source:
#Arutha#
	His fortress at óSar-Sargoth is three hundred miles to the North and I doubt he has the resources to defend a line that long.�
entries.translation:
#亞魯莎#
	他位於ó薩薩戈斯的要塞，遠在三百哩之外的北方，我懷疑他沒有足夠的資源，能守住這麼長的防線。�

entries.source:
#Arutha#
	Feelings aside, I will call up the militia reserves from óMalac's óCross, óDarkmoor, and óLyton and join them to a detachment of the Krondorian Lancers just outside of the Dimwood.�
entries.translation:
#亞魯莎#
	先不論預感，我會徵召ó馬拉克ó十字鎮、ó黑沼鎮ó與萊頓的民兵預備隊，會同幽暗林外一支克朗多槍騎兵分隊。�

entries.source: Even as they threw the door open, James bit back the impulse to vomit. Kingdom soldiers lay scattered about the room, each lying in his own coagulating pool of blood. Nowhere did there appear to be anyone untouched by murderous hands...�
entries.translation: 門一推開，詹姆士便強忍住反胃的衝動。房裡橫七豎八躺著王國士兵的屍體，個個浸在自己凝結的血泊之中。放眼望去，似乎無一人能逃過那雙殺人的手……�

entries.source:
#James#
	I have had it with your mysterious half-answers, moredhel! Now for the sake of your continued good health, I want to hear some explanations fast why you were here in Romney a six-month before you made your appearance at the Inclindel Pass.�
entries.translation:
#詹姆士#
	你那些神神秘秘、答一半藏一半的說法，我受夠了，莫瑞德人！為了你自己的健康著想，我要你趕緊解釋清楚：你半年前就已經出現在羅姆尼，怎麼會又在因克林德爾山口現身？�

entries.source:
#Gorath#
	The only explanation Seigneur is that you are mistaken. I have ónever been south of the Inclindel...�
entries.translation:
#戈拉斯#
	唯一的解釋，紳爵，是你弄錯了。我ó從未踏足因克林德爾以南……�

entries.source:
#James#
	While we carried the dead from the Black Sheep Tavern, a tavern boy informed me that a man answering to your description called on three unwholesomes dressed in black, all of whom wore the trademark silver rings of the Nighthawks. He heard them refer to the moredhel as óGorath!�
entries.translation:
#詹姆士#
	我們從黑羊酒館抬出屍體時，一個酒館小廝告訴我，有個外貌與你相符的人，找上了三個一身黑衣的可疑人物，個個都戴著夜鷹會的招牌銀戒。他聽見他們稱呼那個莫瑞德人為ó戈拉斯！�

entries.source:
#James#
	It seems that this moredhel paid a sizeable sum of money to those Nighthawks before departing, enough perhaps to arrange the death of a company of the King's soldiers?�
entries.translation:
#詹姆士#
	看來這個莫瑞德人離開前，付了一大筆錢給那些夜鷹會的人——或許就足夠買下一整連王家士兵的性命？�

entries.source:
#Gorath#
	He may well have paid a king's death, but I know nothing of it. I realize it may impress little upon you but Gorath is a passing ñcommon name in the Northlands and oft as not your Kingdom fellow folk have mistaken ñme for an elf! The barkeeper was likely deceived by enemies of mine.�
entries.translation:
#戈拉斯#
	他或許真花錢買了一條王家性命，但我對此一無所知。我知道這話對你起不了什麼作用，但『戈拉斯』在北地是個ñ常見的名字，你們王國的人也常把ñ我誤認成精靈！那個酒保多半是被我的仇家給騙了。�

entries.source:
#Gorath#
	If I had cause to mislead you or your Prince, I would have found a far less convoluted means of confusing the royal sanity. Look elsewhere for your enemies, James. While we may not be friends, I mean you no harm.�
entries.translation:
#戈拉斯#
	若我真想誤導你或你的王子，大可用不著這麼繞彎子的手段來擾亂王家的心智。去別處找你的敵人吧，詹姆士。你我雖非朋友，但我無意加害於你。�

entries.source:
#James#
	I shall look where I wish until you are no longer my responsibility.�
entries.translation:
#詹姆士#
	在你不再是我的責任之前，我想查哪裡就查哪裡。�

entries.source:
#James#
	We may not be able to strike at the Nighthawk stronghold, but if we can locate it, we may still be able to get inside and find the information Prince Arutha needs.�
entries.translation:
#詹姆士#
	我們或許無法直搗夜鷹會的據點，但只要能找出位置，說不定還是能潛入其中，找到亞魯莎王子需要的情報。�

entries.source:
#Gorath#
	The Nighthawks will shun Romney for a time. However bold they may be in their murderous nights, they flee when daylight breaks.�
entries.translation:
#戈拉斯#
	夜鷹會一時之間會避開羅姆尼。他們在殺戮的夜裡再大膽，天光一亮便會遁逃。�

entries.source:
#James#
	No one walks without leaving footprints and these men are no different. However skilled they may be at assassination, they have never been any good at covering their tracks. Let me see those things you found in the tavern.�
entries.translation:
#詹姆士#
	沒有人走路不留痕跡，這些人也不例外。他們刺殺的手法再高明，掩蓋行蹤的本事向來不怎麼樣。把你在酒館裡找到的東西給我看看。�

entries.source:
#Gorath#
They are here.�
entries.translation:
#戈拉斯#
東西在這裡。�

entries.source:
#James#
	Good. Those are our footprints. Of all the items we found on the dead company, both those items seemed conspicuously out of place and may be related in some way to our elusive murderers.�
entries.translation:
#詹姆士#
	好。這就是我們要找的痕跡。在陣亡士兵身上找到的所有物品裡，就屬這兩樣格外突兀，多半跟那些神出鬼沒的凶手脫不了關係。�

entries.source:
#James#
	We begin our hunt for the Nighthawks with a spider and a spyglass.�
entries.translation:
#詹姆士#
	我們追查夜鷹會的線索，就從一隻蜘蛛跟一副望遠鏡開始。�

entries.source:
#Narab#
	As much as I would enjoy delivering your carcass to Delekhan I will reserve the pleasure of your execution for him.�
entries.translation:
#納拉布#
	雖然我很樂意把你的屍體送去給迪勒肯，但處決你這份樂趣，我還是留給他親自享用吧。�

entries.source:
#Narab#
Do not move, Gorath.  You are completely surrounded.�
entries.translation:
#納拉布#
別動，戈拉斯。你已經被團團包圍了。�

entries.source:
#Delekhan#
	I see my assistants have been overzealous in their efforts to sedate you! It is proper to ótremble when you are addressed by Delekhan, leader of the unified tribes of the Northlands!�
entries.translation:
#迪勒肯#
	看來我的手下為了讓你安分，出手是重了些！在北地聯合部族的領袖迪勒肯面前，ó顫抖才是應有的禮數！�

entries.source:
#Delekhan#
	We found this among your things Kingdom dog. Tell me where you were going with it!�
entries.translation:
#迪勒肯#
	這是我們在你的行囊裡找到的，王國走狗。告訴我，你帶著它是要去哪裡！�

entries.source:
#Owyn#
	We weren't taking it anywhere. We just picked up everything we could carry and ran. We needed gold...�
entries.translation:
#歐文#
	我們沒打算帶去哪裡。我們只是能拿多少就拿多少，然後就跑了。我們需要錢……�

entries.source:
#Delekhan#
	A lie! The seal that the Nighthawks use for our messages was broken. The new writing at the bottom of the page confirms your guilt. What does Gabot's Folly mean? Who are Arthur and Jimmy the Hand?�
entries.translation:
#迪勒肯#
	撒謊！夜鷹會傳訊用的封印被拆開過。頁尾新添的字跡，證實了你的罪行。『加博特的蠢事』是什麼意思？亞瑟跟神偷吉米又是誰？�

entries.source:
#Owyn#
	I really have no idea. Someone else must have beaten us to it and opened the scroll before we got there. We took what we found and left before we got nabbed. Do you want us to cut you in on the booty?�
entries.translation:
#歐文#
	我真的不知道。一定是有別人搶先一步，在我們到之前就拆開了那卷軸。我們拿了找到的東西，趁還沒被逮到之前就跑了。你要不要分一杯羹？�

entries.source:
#Delekhan#
	What I want is information! Your companion Gorath damns you as certainly as your lie does. Until he betrayed his own, he was second in power only to me. He shall die for his disloyalty.�
entries.translation:
#迪勒肯#
	我要的是情報！你的同夥戈拉斯，跟你的謊言一樣，都已經把你自己給出賣了。在他背叛族人之前，他的地位僅次於我。他將為自己的不忠付出死亡的代價。�

entries.source:
#Delekhan#
	Since you choose to remain silent, I shall have your tongue and feed it to my rats. Have back your message, spy. It will do you little good in your grave.�
entries.translation:
#迪勒肯#
	既然你選擇沉默，那我就割下你的舌頭，拿去餵老鼠。把你的訊息拿回去吧，間諜。反正你進了墳墓也用不上。�

entries.source:
#Gorath#
	...evaded capture and at last we were intercepted by your guards in the Inclindel Pass. The journey south to your camp here outside the Dimwood took many long days but we moved with great haste as our message is vital.�
entries.translation:
#戈拉斯#
	……躲過了追捕，最後在因克林德爾山口被你的守衛攔下。一路南下到幽暗林外你的營地，走了漫長的許多天，但我們一路兼程趕路，因為這份訊息事關重大。�

entries.source:
#Arutha#
	Very interesting tale, but how do I know a word of it is true? How can I believe that this scroll you have given me is the genuine article and not a forgery trumped up by Delekhan?�
entries.translation:
#亞魯莎#
	故事說得挺精彩，但我怎麼知道有幾分是真的？我要如何相信你交給我的這卷卷軸是真品，而不是迪勒肯捏造出來的偽造品？�

entries.source:
#Arutha#
	I was very explicit with you before, Gorath. I refuse to act until I have word from Seigneur James!�
entries.translation:
#亞魯莎#
	戈拉斯，我先前已經把話說得很明白了。在收到詹姆士紳爵的消息之前，我不會採取任何行動！�

entries.source:
#Owyn#
	He told us to give you a message, but it's...odd, sire.�
entries.translation:
#歐文#
	他要我們帶個口信給您，但這……有點奇怪，陛下。�

entries.source:
#Arutha#
	What óexactly did he say?�
entries.translation:
#亞魯莎#
	他ó確切怎麼說的？�

entries.source:
#Owyn#
	He said to tell you that there's a party at mother's...�
entries.translation:
#歐文#
	他要我們轉告您，說『媽媽家有一場宴會……』�

entries.source:
#Arutha#
	...and a good time will be had by all. Gods, Laurie and Jimmy used that phrase years ago! All's right then! James has just saved the pair of you your necks and me a good portion of grief.�
entries.translation:
#亞魯莎#
	『……大家都會玩得盡興。』天啊，這是勞瑞跟吉米多年前用過的暗語！那就沒事了！詹姆士剛剛救了你們倆的小命，也替我省了不少麻煩。�

entries.source:
#Arutha#
	Now I must settle down to the matter of finding out what Delekhan is thinking. If this report is correct then the best force he could muster would number at the most two thousands warriors, a pitiful spit in the eye for a castle assault.�
entries.translation:
#亞魯莎#
	現在我得靜下心來，設法弄清楚迪勒肯到底在打什麼主意。若這份情報屬實，他能召集的最大兵力也不過兩千名戰士，用來攻打城堡，實在寒酸得可憐。�

entries.source:
#Gorath#
	You believe he has something else in mind.�
entries.translation:
#戈拉斯#
	你認為他另有所圖。�

entries.source:
#Arutha#
	Undoubtedly. As James indicated in his brief note, it would take some spectacular strategy on Delekhan's part to take the castle, and honestly, he has never displayed that kind of ñwitð. We faced him before when he was still a field captain for Murmandamus. Wherever he is going he will no doubt hit fast and run for high ground. Now we have to establish where that high ground is.�
entries.translation:
#亞魯莎#
	肯定是。正如詹姆士簡短的口信所暗示，要攻下城堡，迪勒肯得拿出相當出色的戰略才行，但老實說，他向來沒展現過那種ñ機智ð。我們以前跟他交過手，那時他還只是穆爾曼達穆斯麾下的一名野戰隊長。不管他打算去哪，肯定是速戰速決，然後退往高地。現在我們得查出那塊高地究竟在哪裡。�

entries.source:
#Gorath#
	Shall we accompany you to Northwarden?�
entries.translation:
#戈拉斯#
	我們該隨您前往北衛城嗎？�

entries.source:
#Arutha#
	No. I have a much more important task for you, though I doubt you will find it as exciting. I need you to return to Krondor immediately.�
entries.translation:
#亞魯莎#
	不必。我有件更重要的任務要交給你們，雖然我猜你們大概不會覺得多刺激。我需要你們立刻返回克朗多。�

entries.source:
#Arutha#
	Inform Master Magician Pug of the situation. Considering his tactics, I have a feeling Delekhan may have a few surprises in store for us. If that bastard brings anything magical to bear I want to know what it is and how to counteract it.�
entries.translation:
#亞魯莎#
	把情況告知大法師帕格。看迪勒肯用兵的手法，我有預感他還藏著幾手驚喜。若那混蛋動用了什麼法術手段，我要知道那是什麼、又該如何應對。�

entries.source:
#Arutha#
You leave immediately.�
entries.translation:
#亞魯莎#
你們立刻動身。�

entries.source:
#Gorath#
	Shall we accompany you to Northwarden?�
entries.translation:
#戈拉斯#
	我們該隨您前往北衛城嗎？�

entries.source:
#Arutha#
	No. I have a much more important task for you, though I doubt you will find it as exciting. I need you to return to Krondor immediately.�
entries.translation:
#亞魯莎#
	不必。我有件更重要的任務要交給你們，雖然我猜你們大概不會覺得多刺激。我需要你們立刻返回克朗多。�

entries.source:
#Patrus#
	...And if it weren't bad enough I had to chase you, you made me get rocks in my best shoes! I'm blistered! Know how mad I get when my feet hurt? I get river bottom mud sucking badger whacked mad...�
entries.translation:
#派特魯斯#
	……追你們追得我都快沒力了，你們還害我最好的一雙鞋子灌滿了石子！腳都磨出水泡了！你們知道我腳痛的時候有多火大嗎？我會氣得跟被踩到尾巴的獾一樣，兇得跟河底爛泥巴打滾似的……�

entries.source:
#James#
	Excuse us...�
entries.translation:
#詹姆士#
	打擾了……�

entries.source:
#Patrus#
	Go way. I'm busy right now agitatin' this here moredhel...�
entries.translation:
#派特魯斯#
	走開啦。我正忙著教訓這個莫瑞德人呢……�

entries.source:
#James#
	Begging your pardon, but I am Seigneur James...and this...and this is...Seigneur Locklear. We have been sent...by the Baron Gabot...to find...you. You are his magical adviser, aren't you?�
entries.translation:
#詹姆士#
	打擾了，在下是詹姆士紳爵……這位……這位是……洛克利爾紳爵。我們是奉……加博特男爵之命……前來尋……找您的。您是他的法術顧問，對吧？�

entries.source:
#Patrus#
	Just Patrus, please. I don't ken to titles much. Glad to meet you. I've just been out trying to get some information about these moredhel. They've been gettin' too close to the castle and it was makin' my tongue itch. Man can't respectably eat thataways.�
entries.translation:
#派特魯斯#
	叫我派特魯斯就好。我不怎麼講究頭銜這套。幸會幸會。我剛才正忙著打探這些莫瑞德人的消息。他們越靠越近城堡了，弄得我心癢難耐。這樣下去，人哪能安安穩穩吃頓飯。�

entries.source:
#James#
	Have you...learned anything about the attack?�
entries.translation:
#詹姆士#
	您……打探到什麼攻擊的消息了嗎？�

entries.source:
#Patrus#
	Only that there's six companies of 'em out creepin' in the woods somewhere but I don't know exactly where yet. I think they've got their own magicians, too.�
entries.translation:
#派特魯斯#
	只知道有六個連的莫瑞德人正在林子裡某處潛伏著，但確切地點還沒查出來。我猜他們自己也帶了法師。�

entries.source:
#James#
	Magicians?! The Baron will be sorry to hear that I'll wager. We need to return to the castle. Which way would be quickest?�
entries.translation:
#詹姆士#
	法師？！我敢打賭男爵聽了肯定不高興。我們得趕回城堡才行。走哪條路最快？�

entries.source:
#Patrus#
	Northwarden? Oh, well it's THATAWAY...�
entries.translation:
#派特魯斯#
	北衛城？喔，就在那——邊……�

entries.source:
#James#
	I was beginning to believe you were going to miss all the fun!�
entries.translation:
#詹姆士#
	我還以為您要錯過這場好戲了呢！�

entries.source:
#Arutha#
	Delekhan would think me impolite if I didn't attend his little party. How are the men?�
entries.translation:
#亞魯莎#
	若我不出席迪勒肯這場小小的宴會，他恐怕會覺得我失禮了。將士們的情況如何？�

entries.source:
#James#
	Very bad. Of the original garrison of four hundred and fifteen men, two hundred twenty seven are dead, thirty five are mortally wounded and the rest are afflicted with dysentery or are too exhausted to wield a sword. Your arrival came none too soon.�
entries.translation:
#詹姆士#
	情況很糟。原本四百一十五人的守軍，兩百二十七人已經陣亡，三十五人身受重傷、命在旦夕，剩下的不是染上痢疾，就是累得連劍都揮不動。您來得正是時候。�

entries.source:
#James#
	No discourtesy intended, Prince, but why did you wait so long in coming?�
entries.translation:
#詹姆士#
	王子殿下，恕我直言，您為何拖了這麼久才趕來？�

entries.source:
#Arutha#
	We made all haste, nearly to the point of calamity! Your well-meaning messengers bumped into trouble and nearly didn't win themselves free. Consequently we didn't receive your word until it was nearly too late for us to respond. We were greatly fortunate to arrive as soon as we did.�
entries.translation:
#亞魯莎#
	我們已經是拼盡全力趕路了，差點就要出大事！你們一片好意派來的信使中途出了岔子，差點脫不了身。因此我們遲遲收不到消息，等收到時幾乎已經來不及應對。能這麼快趕到，已經是萬幸了。�

entries.source:
#James#
	The moredhel are in retreat?�
entries.translation:
#詹姆士#
	莫瑞德人在撤退了？�

entries.source:
#Arutha#
	What few of them remain. By the accounts of my scouts, they think there may have been up to at least six companies in the hills.�
entries.translation:
#亞魯莎#
	剩下的殘兵而已。據我的斥候回報，他們估計山丘上至少曾有六個連的兵力。�

entries.source:
#James#
	About that. Since they didn't have the decency to attack all at once, we couldn't tell.�
entries.translation:
#詹姆士#
	這個嘛。他們沒禮貌到不肯一次全部攻過來，我們也數不清楚。�

entries.source:
#Arutha#
	If our trackers are to be believed, four of those companies slipped out a week ago while the other two kept your forces pinned down. The rest apparently turned southwest.�
entries.translation:
#亞魯莎#
	若我方的追蹤者所言不假，其中四個連早在一週前就已經悄悄撤離，只留下兩個連牽制你們的兵力。其餘的顯然轉往西南方去了。�

entries.source:
#James#
	Sounds like they mean to strike at Highcastle.�
entries.translation:
#詹姆士#
	聽起來他們是打算進攻高堡。�

entries.source:
#Arutha#
	Undoubtedly. Since the moredhel leader has mimicked many of the moves that his predecessor Murmandamus made, it stands to reason he may make many of the same mistakes.�
entries.translation:
#亞魯莎#
	肯定是。既然這位莫瑞德領袖處處仿效前任首領穆爾曼達穆斯的手法，那他多半也會犯下類似的錯誤，這也合情合理。�

entries.source:
#Arutha#
	As a precaution, I split my forces and diverted half of them to Highcastle. As soon as we are finished cleaning up here, I will take the rest of our companies to engage him there.�
entries.translation:
#亞魯莎#
	為求謹慎，我已分兵，將半數兵力調往高堡。等這裡的殘局收拾乾淨，我便會率領剩下的部隊，趕去那裡與他交戰。�

entries.source:
#Pug#
Arrayed in flame the enemy comes,
To shriek his cadence on skeleton drums...�
entries.translation:
#帕格#
烈焰披身，敵軍將至，
枯骨為鼓，奏響哀鳴……�

entries.source:
#Makala#
...For thunder's spite we'll raise our call,
Though down shall crumble Empire all.�
entries.translation:
#馬卡拉#
……縱使雷霆震怒，吾等仍將高聲應戰，
縱使帝國傾頹，亦在所不惜。�

entries.source:
#Makala#
	A Tsurani poet. I believe he was House Omechan...�
entries.translation:
#馬卡拉#
	一位圖蘭尼詩人所作。我記得他是歐米強家的人……�

entries.source:
#Pug#
	House Minwanabi, reign of the fifty third Light of Heaven.�
entries.translation:
#帕格#
	是米瓦內比家，出自第五十三代天光統治時期。�

entries.source:
#Pug#
	Is there something you need to see me about Makala? I am...busy.�
entries.translation:
#帕格#
	馬卡拉，你來找我有什麼事嗎？我……正忙著。�

entries.source:
#Makala#
	Busy? You have been behaving like a needra bull with a burr in his bit! I came to ask what has Pug of Stardock so distracted that he cannot find time to meet with his associate magicians? Has his reputation so inflated that a member of the Tsurani Assembly is no longer worthy of his attention?�
entries.translation:
#馬卡拉#
	忙？你最近的樣子，活像屁股裡卡了根刺的涅德拉公牛！我是來問問，究竟是什麼事，讓星塢島的帕格分心到連見同僚法師的時間都擠不出來？還是說，你名聲太響，已經不屑理會圖蘭尼法師議會的一員了？�

entries.source:
#Pug#
	I am sorry. Perhaps you are right, I've just been very preoccupied.�
entries.translation:
#帕格#
	抱歉。或許你說得對，我只是心裡有太多事情罷了。�

entries.source:
#Pug#
	I find myself ñobsessed with this storm. All week I've felt it building over the Bitter Sea and all the while I have suspected there is more to it than is immediately perceptible. It doesn't feel natural. Have you seen its like?�
entries.translation:
#帕格#
	我發現自己ñ滿腦子都是這場風暴。一整週以來，我都感覺得到它正在苦海上空醞釀成形，而我也一直懷疑，這當中恐怕不只是表面看起來那麼簡單。感覺不太自然。你見過類似的景象嗎？�

entries.source:
#Makala#
	I have seen its match in destruction. As I recall, you created far more havoc in Tsuranuanni when you disrupted my Emperor's Imperial Games. Several city blocks destroyed, countless lives lost, the Warlord cast down in dishonor...�
entries.translation:
#馬卡拉#
	論破壞力，我倒是見過旗鼓相當的景象。我記得，你當年在圖蘭努安尼攪亂了我皇的帝國競技大會，鬧出的動靜可比這大得多。整整幾個街區被夷為平地，無數性命就此喪生，戰爭大人也因此蒙羞下台……�

entries.source:
#Pug#
	I had a ófeeling you didn't summon a rift-door to chastise me about my lack of attention. What is this about, Makala?�
entries.translation:
#帕格#
	我ó猜想你召開裂界之門，不是為了來訓斥我心不在焉的。到底是什麼事，馬卡拉？�

entries.source:
#Makala#
	Your loyalties, Pug. While you claim loyalty to the Empire, you live your life under the influence of a Midkemian King and took to wife a Thuril highlander. Your judgement is suspect!�
entries.translation:
#馬卡拉#
	你的忠誠，帕格。你口口聲聲效忠帝國，卻長年生活在米德凱米亞國王的統治之下，還娶了圖里爾高地的女子為妻。你的判斷力，令人生疑！�

entries.source:
#Pug#
	From the day I left the Empire, my judgement and my loyalties ceased to be the concern of the Assembly of Magicians. I do what I see is best for all concerned.�
entries.translation:
#帕格#
	自我離開帝國那天起，我的判斷與忠誠，就不再是法師議會該操心的事了。我只做我認為對各方最好的事。�

entries.source:
#Makala#
	I see. Then, is any act justifiable to that end?�
entries.translation:
#馬卡拉#
	原來如此。那麼，只要目的正當，任何手段都能被正當化嗎？�

entries.source:
#Pug#
	If it serves the common good, yes.�
entries.translation:
#帕格#
	只要有利於大局，就可以。�

entries.source:
#Makala#
	Even if it violates an individual's rights?�
entries.translation:
#馬卡拉#
	即使侵犯了個人的權利也一樣？�

entries.source:
#Pug#
	What do you wish for me to say, Makala?! You lead me as if I were one of your needra cows but I am in no mood for games. State your business.�
entries.translation:
#帕格#
	你到底想聽我說什麼，馬卡拉？！你牽著我團團轉，像在牽你的涅德拉母牛一樣，但我沒心情陪你玩這套。有話直說。�

entries.source:
#Makala#
	Very well...Your daughter Gamina has blossomed into a remarkable young woman. She is beautiful, gracious and an honor to your house. Unfortunately, she is also a girl with remarkable powers.�
entries.translation:
#馬卡拉#
	好吧……你的女兒蓋米娜，已經出落成一位出眾的年輕女子。她美麗、優雅，是你家族的榮耀。可惜的是，她同時也是個力量驚人的女孩。�

entries.source:
#Pug#
	My estimation of a person's magical talents is not determined by their sex, Makala, and I refuse to murder my child to appease a barbaric tenant of the Assembly! They have no authority in Midkemia!�
entries.translation:
#帕格#
	我評斷一個人的法術天賦，向來不看性別，馬卡拉，我也絕不會為了迎合法師議會那條野蠻的教條，就去謀殺自己的孩子！他們在米德凱米亞沒有任何權柄！�

entries.source:
#Makala#
	In this instance, I believe they will choose to ignore the geography. At this juncture, the Assembly is troubled--- surrounded by anti-traditionalists who embrace your Midkemian values, led in large part by Mara of the Acoma.�
entries.translation:
#馬卡拉#
	這件事上，我相信他們會選擇無視地理的隔閡。此刻議會正陷入困擾——四面都是擁抱你米德凱米亞價值觀的反傳統派，其中大半是由阿科瑪的瑪拉所領導。�

entries.source:
#Makala#
	Although I am equally wary of female abomination, I have no desire to see your daughter dead. I have acted on your behalf and placed her in exile until such a time we can agree upon her ultimate fate...�
entries.translation:
#馬卡拉#
	雖然我同樣對女性異能心存戒懼，但我並不希望看見你的女兒喪命。我已經代你行事，先將她放逐在外，直到我們能就她最終的命運達成共識為止……�

entries.source:
#Pug#
	ãWãhãyã ãdãiãdãnã'ãtã ãyãoãuã ãcãoãnãsãuãlãtã ãmãeã?ã ãWãhãeãrãeã ãhãaãvãeã ãyãoãuã ãsãeãnãtã ãhãeãrã?ã!�
entries.translation:
#帕格#
	ã你ã為ã何ã事ã先ã不ã找ã我ã商ã量ã就ã把ã她ã送ã走ã了ã呢ã你ã究ã竟ã把ã她ã送ã到ã什ã麼ã地ã方ã去ã了ã…ã…ã…ã…ã…ã…ã…ã…ã…ã…ã…ã…ã…ã…ã…ã…ã…ã…ã…ã…ã…ã…�

entries.source:
#Makala#
	Seek her if you wish, but it will avail you little. Your further interference will likely ensure that the Assembly will carry out its order of death. They will be unable to kill her, however, if they cannot find her. It would be to your advantage to leave her be.�
entries.translation:
#馬卡拉#
	你想找她就去找吧，但這樣做於事無補。你再插手，只會讓議會更堅決執行死亡的判決。不過，只要他們找不到她，就殺不了她。放手不管，對你才是最有利的。�

entries.source:
#Pug#
	I will not content myself to sit here while the Assembly banters about the value of my daughter's life! I shall find her and then you tell your brethren to expect my visit!�
entries.translation:
#帕格#
	我不會坐在這裡，任憑議會拿我女兒的性命當作談資！我會找到她，然後你去告訴你那些同僚，等著我親自登門拜訪！�

entries.source:
#Makala#
	You embark on a dangerous road but it is yours to take. Farewell then, Pug...�
entries.translation:
#馬卡拉#
	你踏上的是一條危險的路，但那是你自己的選擇。那麼，就此別過了，帕格……�

entries.source:
#Makala#
	Open defiance by you as our most notable member could weaken our position within the Empire and that is something we cannot afford! We would be forced to make you publicly comply.�
entries.translation:
#馬卡拉#
	你身為我們最具聲望的成員，若公然抗命，會削弱我們在帝國中的地位——這是我們承擔不起的！屆時我們將不得不逼你公開就範。�

entries.source:
#Makala#
	Your love for your daughter has led you into a grievous miscarriage of your duties! óWhy óhave óyou ólet óher ólive?�
entries.translation:
#馬卡拉#
	你對女兒的愛，已經讓你在職責上犯下嚴重的過失！ó你ó為何ó還ó讓ó她ó活著？�

entries.source:
#Gorath#
	We may not be the strongest or the fastest Tomas, but we are able and we are here. Send us to him.�
entries.translation:
#戈拉斯#
	托馬斯，我們或許不是最強、最快的人選，但我們有能力，也已經在此。派我們去找他吧。�

entries.source:
#Tomas#
	I have little choice. You, Gorath, shall be my emissary in this. May the blessings of Elvandar go with you...and tell Pug I am sorry.�
entries.translation:
#托馬斯#
	我沒有太多選擇。戈拉斯，這次就由你，作為我的使者。願艾爾凡達的祝福與你同行……並轉告帕格，我很抱歉。�

entries.source:
#Gorath#
We shall.�
entries.translation:
#戈拉斯#
我們會的。�

entries.source:
#Arutha#
	Cooperate now moredhel and I promise you'll live to see your children become adults. Daunt me and I'll have your eyes for necklace beads and your manhood for an inkwell!�
entries.translation:
#亞魯莎#
	莫瑞德人，現在乖乖合作，我保證讓你活著看到你的孩子長大成人。若敢反抗，我就挖了你的眼珠子做項鍊，割了你的命根子當墨水瓶！�

entries.source:
#Moredhel#
	My death will be unimportant...�
entries.translation:
#莫瑞德人#
	我的死，無關緊要……�

entries.source:
#Arutha#
	If you think we shall torture you unto death, I would advise that you ponder my mood. Anxious though I am to have answer, I will keep you screaming this side of death a month or a year or until I feel well satisfied that we have heard all that you have to say!�
entries.translation:
#亞魯莎#
	你若以為我們會把你活活折磨致死，我勸你好好揣摩一下我此刻的心情。雖然我急著想要答案，但我可以讓你在死亡邊緣哀嚎一個月、一年，直到我滿意聽完你要說的一切為止！�

entries.source:
#Moredhel#
	A day, a month, you've already lost! Nail my entrails to your door post, feed...my brain to your dogs, it will not matter! Even if you act now, you will be too late!�
entries.translation:
#莫瑞德人#
	一天也好，一個月也罷，你們早就輸了！把我的內臟釘在你的門柱上，把我的腦子……拿去餵狗，都無所謂！就算你現在動手，也已經太遲了！�

entries.source:
#Arutha#
	You will win only pain for your trouble! Instruct him, torturer!�
entries.translation:
#亞魯莎#
	你只會為自己招來痛苦！動手吧，行刑人！�

entries.source:
#Moredhel#
	You do...not...listen!�
entries.translation:
#莫瑞德人#
	你根本……不……聽！�

entries.source:
#Moredhel#
	We know...the secret of Se-thanon! We shall free him!�
entries.translation:
#莫瑞德人#
	我們知道……賽瑟儂的祕密！我們將會釋放他！�

entries.source:
#Arutha#
	What secret? Why to Sethanon?�
entries.translation:
#亞魯莎#
	什麼祕密？為何是賽瑟儂？�

entries.source:
#Moredhel#
	Ten years ago we attacked...with Murmandamus..you captured, imprisoned him...�
entries.translation:
#莫瑞德人#
	十年前，我們曾發動攻擊……跟穆爾曼達穆斯一起……你們俘虜了他、囚禁了他……�

entries.source:
#Arutha#
	Deluded fool, we killed Murmandamus at Sethanon and burned his bones for potash! There is nothing there for Delekhan to find!�
entries.translation:
#亞魯莎#
	愚蠢的傻子，穆爾曼達穆斯早在賽瑟儂就已死於我們手中，屍骨都燒成了灰！那裡根本沒有什麼東西，能讓迪勒肯找到！�

entries.source:
#Moredhel#
	A lie...we have spied...What else could...you guard so closely?�
entries.translation:
#莫瑞德人#
	騙人……我們早已探得……不然還有什麼……值得你們如此嚴加看守？�

entries.source:
#Arutha#
	How does he think he will win past our garrison at Highcastle! He hasn't enough men!�
entries.translation:
#亞魯莎#
	他以為憑什麼能突破我們在高堡的守軍！他的兵力根本不夠！�

entries.source:
#Arutha#
Answer me!�
entries.translation:
#亞魯莎#
回答我！�

entries.source:
#Moredhel#
	Riiift-machine!...The Six have a machine...It can take them place to place...like a door between great distances...Even while your troops die at Sethanon...we will walk through the machine!�
entries.translation:
#莫瑞德人#
	裂——裂界機！……六賢者有一台機器……能帶他們從一處到另一處……就像一扇連接遠方的門……即使你們的軍隊在賽瑟儂送死……我們也會直接穿過那台機器！�

entries.source:
#Moredhel#
	We shall be through the Dimwood and inside Sethanon a week before you can reach us! Your troops will be exhausted! The day will be ours!�
entries.translation:
#莫瑞德人#
	我們會穿過幽暗林，早在你們趕到的一週前，就已經進了賽瑟儂！你們的軍隊將疲憊不堪！勝利將屬於我們！�

entries.source:
#Arutha#
	A rift-machine inside the Dimwood! That bastard Tsurani magician has been consorting with Delekhan!�
entries.translation:
#亞魯莎#
	幽暗林裡竟有一台裂界機！那個該死的圖蘭尼法師，一直在跟迪勒肯勾結！�

entries.source:
#Arutha#
	Torturer, tell Seigneurs James and Locklear to ride to the Dimwood. They must find and destroy that rift-machine while I hie to Highcastle and divert our forces once more! Time is of the essence!�
entries.translation:
#亞魯莎#
	行刑人，去通知詹姆士紳爵跟洛克利爾紳爵，立刻騎馬趕往幽暗林。他們必須找到並摧毀那台裂界機，我則趕赴高堡，再次調度我方兵力！事不宜遲！�

entries.source: An angry scream of air raked at James and Locklear like the claw of an invisible beast, tugging at them as if to stuff them whole into the insatiable black maw of the collapsing rift machine. Desperately they called out to Patrus to grab on to something, but for him it was too late...�
entries.translation: 一陣狂暴的氣旋怒嘯而起，如無形巨獸的利爪撕扯著詹姆士與洛克利爾，彷彿要將他們整個吞入那正在崩塌的裂界機，塞進那貪婪的黑暗之口。他們拼命呼喊派特魯斯抓住些什麼，但對他來說，已經太遲了……�

entries.source:
#Patrus#
Stay back! Stay back!�
entries.translation:
#派特魯斯#
退後！退後！�

entries.source:
#Locklear#
Spellweavers!�
entries.translation:
#洛克利爾#
織法者！�

entries.source:
#Patrus#
	AIGHHHH!!!�
entries.translation:
#派特魯斯#
	啊啊啊啊！！！�

entries.source:
#Pug#
	She lives. Makala has many blessings to count.�
entries.translation:
#帕格#
	她還活著。馬卡拉，你該慶幸自己走運。�

entries.source:
#Pug#
	Gorath, see if you can do something about the cage...�
entries.translation:
#帕格#
	戈拉斯，看你能不能想想辦法處理那個牢籠……�

entries.source:
#Gorath#
	Cover your head and stand back!�
entries.translation:
#戈拉斯#
	護住頭，退後！�

entries.source:
#Pug#
	Stay your swords, Seigneurs. I believe it is still considered rude in the Kingdom to skewer your friends.�
entries.translation:
#帕格#
	紳爵們，收劍吧。我記得在王國，把朋友刺穿好像還是很失禮的事。�

entries.source:
#James#
	Duke Pug! Never have I been half so relieved to see a friendly face. We were expecting moredhel magicians...�
entries.translation:
#詹姆士#
	帕格公爵！我從沒有這麼慶幸見到一張友善的臉。我們還以為會碰上莫瑞德法師呢……�

entries.source:
#Pug#
	Tsurani magicians, James, or rather magicians trained by a Tsurani. No moredhel witch would have the capability to make a rift machine nor would they chance going into battle with such poor odds of success.�
entries.translation:
#帕格#
	是圖蘭尼法師，詹姆士，或者說是受過圖蘭尼人訓練的法師。莫瑞德巫者沒有能力打造裂界機，也不會冒險投入一場勝算如此渺茫的戰鬥。�

entries.source:
#Pug#
	I still should like to know how exactly it was that Delekhan managed to make contact with Makala? I had hoped that the moredhel would be wary of another such attack following the defeat of Murmandamus ten years ago.�
entries.translation:
#帕格#
	我還是很想知道，迪勒肯究竟是怎麼跟馬卡拉搭上線的？我原以為，自從十年前穆爾曼達穆斯戰敗之後，莫瑞德人應該會對再次發動這種攻勢有所顧忌才對。�

entries.source:
#James#
	Prince Arutha said they hope to find Murmandamus and free him. The moredhel are convinced we've been holding him captive all these long years.�
entries.translation:
#詹姆士#
	亞魯莎王子說，他們希望找到穆爾曼達穆斯並釋放他。莫瑞德人深信，這麼多年來，我們一直把他囚禁著。�

entries.source:
#Pug#
	So Gorath has told me. Doubtless Makala exploited that belief to his advantage. That at least explains one wrinkle. The moredhel have never forgiven us for that loss.�
entries.translation:
#帕格#
	戈拉斯也是這麼告訴我的。馬卡拉肯定是利用了這個信念，為自己謀利。這至少解開了一個疑點。莫瑞德人始終沒有原諒我們當年的那場敗仗。�

entries.source:
#James#
	But why is Makala doing all of this? Obviously he isn't in this to rescue a dead moredhel leader.�
entries.translation:
#詹姆士#
	但馬卡拉為什麼要做這一切？他顯然不是為了救回一個早已死去的莫瑞德領袖。�

entries.source:
#Pug#
	For the moment I believe I know, but I don't wish to say until I have taken a better look at something. This last problem I will have to unravel myself, with some assistance from Gorath and Owyn.�
entries.translation:
#帕格#
	目前我心裡大概有數，但在我把某件事看清楚之前，還不想說出口。這最後的謎團，得由我親自解開，戈拉斯跟歐文從旁協助。�

entries.source:
#Pug#
	From here I think we will be able to teleport into the caverns beneath Sethanon. It is there our objective lies.�
entries.translation:
#帕格#
	從這裡，我想我們應該能傳送進入賽瑟儂地底的洞穴。我們的目標，就在那裡。�

entries.source:
#James#
	What of Locklear and myself?�
entries.translation:
#詹姆士#
	那洛克利爾跟我呢？�

entries.source:
#Pug#
	Once Prince Arutha arrives with his reinforcements, deliver my assurance that he will not face anything magical from the moredhel. If Makala indeed has assistants, they will be uninterested in the Prince.�
entries.translation:
#帕格#
	等亞魯莎王子率援軍抵達後，替我轉告他，莫瑞德人不會用任何法術手段對付他。若馬卡拉真有幫手，他們也不會對王子感興趣。�

entries.source:
#Pug#
They will be waiting for ñmeð.�
entries.translation:
#帕格#
他們等的是ñ我ð。�

entries.source: Disliking the fact that they would be at a disadvantage against a magical opponent without Patrus, James steeled himself as he grabbed for his weapon...�
entries.translation: 一想到少了派特魯斯，面對法術對手將處於劣勢，詹姆士便打起精神，握緊了手中的武器……�

entries.source:
#Pug#
	I hoped more for you, Makala. When first you came to us years ago from the Assembly I sensed your heart full of dark calculation, but I had thought with us you would grow to gentleness.�
entries.translation:
#帕格#
	馬卡拉，我曾對你抱有更高的期望。多年前你剛從議會來到我們這裡時，我就感覺到你心裡藏著陰暗的算計，但我以為，跟我們相處久了，你會漸漸變得溫和一些。�

entries.source:
#Makala#
	We Tsurani are of course bereft of that quality...�
entries.translation:
#馬卡拉#
	我們圖蘭尼人，本來就沒有那種特質……�

entries.source:
#Pug#
	Save your prating for the Assembly! You have returned my friendship with cold contempt, treated with my daughter as a wolf to his prey and have defied my interdict to visit Sethanon. Assume nothing between us now other than the respect due between practitioners. Why has the Assembly of Magicians seen fit to interpose itself into Midkemian affairs?�
entries.translation:
#帕格#
	你這套空話留給議會聽吧！你用冷酷的輕蔑回報我的友誼，對待我女兒如狼對待獵物，還無視我不准踏足賽瑟儂的禁令。從今以後，你我之間只剩同行之間應有的敬重，別無其他。法師議會憑什麼認為，自己有資格插手米德凱米亞的事務？�

entries.source:
#Makala#
	As a whole, the Assembly was unable to reach consensus on this matter; they hesitate to dabble in matters that might arouse your ire. Otherwise disposed with a small problem concerning House Acoma they decided those who felt this investigation necessary could conduct it of their own volition. I undertook that responsibility.�
entries.translation:
#馬卡拉#
	整體而言，議會在這件事上未能達成共識；他們不太願意插手可能觸怒你的事務。加上又忙於處理阿科瑪家的一樁小麻煩，最後便決定，凡認為有必要調查的人，可自行決定行動。我便承擔下了這份責任。�

entries.source:
#Pug#
	I should be careful taking such weight upon your shoulders. It may yet crush you.�
entries.translation:
#帕格#
	你該小心點，把這樣的重擔攬到自己肩上。它遲早會把你壓垮。�

entries.source:
#Makala#
	Ten years ago you engaged in a battle to bar the Valheru entrance to your world, a battle in which you requested the service of several companies of Tsurani foot soldiers. As such, the battle became a matter of imperial interest and fell within the jurisdiction of the Assembly. You, however, have thwarted all our efforts to gather information about that battle and have forbade our investigation of Sethanon. Many sons of great houses fell but their bodies were never recovered for the proper rites...�
entries.translation:
#馬卡拉#
	十年前，你投身一場戰役，阻止瓦爾赫魯進入你的世界，那場戰役中，你還請求動用了數個連的圖蘭尼步兵。因此，那場戰役便成了帝國的利益所在，落入了議會的管轄範圍。然而你卻百般阻撓我們蒐集那場戰役的情報，還禁止我們調查賽瑟儂。許多名門之後戰死沙場，屍骨卻始終未能尋回、未能得到應有的葬禮……�

entries.source:
#Pug#
	Your attempts at evasion are execrable, Makala! Never has the Assembly concerned itself with the souls of the dead and I don't believe they are practicing a new found piety. You wished to learn how I defeated the Valheru.�
entries.translation:
#帕格#
	馬卡拉，你這套迂迴閃躲的說詞真是拙劣！議會向來不關心亡者的靈魂，我也不相信他們突然信奉起虔誠來了。你想知道的，是我究竟如何擊敗瓦爾赫魯。�

entries.source:
#Makala#
	Indeed. How could we not? The Valheru were a race of unspeakable evil and dread power who once nearly destroyed our world. Although my brothers harbor you the greatest respect Pug, you would be incapable of turning aside such monstrous power unaided. Judging by the numerous defenses that ringed this abandoned town, we assumed the only possible solution. You concealed a thing of power in the caverns here.�
entries.translation:
#馬卡拉#
	沒錯。我們又怎能不想知道？瓦爾赫魯是一支邪惡難以言喻、力量令人畏懼的種族，曾經幾乎毀滅了我們的世界。帕格，雖然我的同僚們對你敬重有加，但你不可能獨力擋下如此可怕的力量。從這座廢棄城鎮周圍層層設下的防禦看來，我們認定只有一種可能——你在這裡的洞穴中，藏了一件力量之物。�

entries.source:
#Pug#
	I cannot fault your fears, but your methodology has been despicable.
	The Lifestone was created in the darkest days of the Mad God's Rage, a war in which the Valheru strove to destroy the gods of Midkemia. With it they believed they could conquer every corner of the universe, and in all likelihood, they could have. It must be eternally locked away here and its existence must die out with that small handful of us that have looked upon it. You will speak to none of the Assembly about what you have found here or you shall answer to ñmeð.�
entries.translation:
#帕格#
	我不怪你們心懷恐懼，但你們的手段實在卑劣。
	生命石誕生於瘋神之怒最黑暗的日子，那場戰爭裡，瓦爾赫魯一心要毀滅米德凱米亞的諸神。他們相信憑藉這件器物，便能征服宇宙的每個角落——而這極有可能是真的。它必須永遠封鎖在此地，它的存在，也必須隨著我們這少數幾個見過它的人一同湮滅。你今天在這裡看到的一切，不准告訴議會裡的任何人，否則你要面對的，就是ñ我ð。�

entries.source:
#Makala#
	I cannot in good conscience keep such a secret. What if such a weapon were wielded against the Empire? Could not such a weapon lay waste to all her children? We cannot simply bury such a weapon. It must be destroyed for the good of all future generations of the Empire ñand the Kingdom.�
entries.translation:
#馬卡拉#
	我良心上無法守住這樣的祕密。萬一這樣的武器被用來對付帝國呢？這樣的武器，難道不會讓她的子民全數化為焦土？我們不能就這樣把它埋起來。為了帝國ñ以及王國未來世世代代著想，它必須被摧毀。�

entries.source:
#Pug#
	Impossible. We have no way to know what would happen if we attempted to destroy it. It may not be tested without potentially disturbing the Valheru whose souls now occupy the stone...�
entries.translation:
#帕格#
	不可能。我們根本無從得知，一旦試圖摧毀它會發生什麼事。若貿然一試，很可能驚動如今困於石中的瓦爾赫魯亡魂……�

entries.source:
#Makala#
	As I suspected. You have done nothing to study it. Great though your power may be, you haven't an inkling what secrets lie within that stone. It's very existence is obscene! It must not fall into the hands of a hostile power.�
entries.translation:
#馬卡拉#
	不出我所料。你根本沒對它做過任何研究。就算你法力再高強，也完全不知道那顆石頭裡究竟藏著什麼祕密。它的存在本身就是一種褻瀆！絕不能讓它落入敵對勢力手中。�

entries.source:
#Pug#
	Makala, do not tamper with the stone. It must be left untouched for the good of all!�
entries.translation:
#帕格#
	馬卡拉，別碰那顆石頭。為了眾人的福祉，它必須維持原封不動！�

	困在石中的瓦爾赫魯亡魂正在掙脫束縛！我們得把他們兩個都殺了……�

entries.source: His reflexes responding when his sensibility had long since fled, Owyn wedded his magical strength to the blast, feeling a simultaneous sensation of horror and elation as the Lifestone chamber crackled with power. In an instant, all that had been Delekhan or Gorath vanished in a concussive blast...�
entries.translation: 歐文的理智早已蕩然無存，唯有反射本能仍在運作，他將自己的法力融入那道爆發之力。生命石密室因龐大的力量而劈啪作響，恐懼與亢奮的感受同時湧上心頭。剎那間，曾是迪勒肯、也曾是戈拉斯的一切，在一陣震盪的爆炸中消失無蹤……�

entries.source:
Owyn stared blankly at the Lifestone.
	"We killed him," Owyn said, a bitter hurt in his words. "He came to the Kingdom to warn us and we killed him."
	"Don't be petulant, Owyn. This isn't a time for it."
	Glaring at Pug with shock, Owyn opened his mouth to reply, but found that adequate words failed him. Angered, he turned as if to leave, but felt the master magician's hand on his shoulder.
	"Wait," Pug said, his voice more gentle than it had been. Meeting the boy's hateful gaze, he motioned for him to stay. "You must understand. Gorath was dead the minute he touched the sword. If we had hesitated another moment longer, both he and Delekhan would be dead and an unspeakable evil would be loose on our world. When Delekhan began to change you could see the valheru were attempting to mold them into a form they could use. Do you remember the terrible devastation we saw on Timirianya? That would be a paradise compared to the lives we would lead under their dominion. I'm telling you this because you now have knowledge and abilities which come with terrible responsibilities. You will have to make decisions far worse than this someday if you continue down the path you are on. You are going to have to learn to think before you act, but never to regret your decisions, right or wrong. Otherwise, you will slowly begin to not make decisions at all."
	"But how can I know which are the right decisions?" Owyn asked. "How can I be sure?"
	Pug squeezed his shoulder. "You need to live to a ripe old age to know that and I am not nearly old enough to have an answer. All I know is what Macros the Black once told me. He said to train those around me well, to make them powerful, but also to make them loving and generous. I see those things in you."�
entries.translation:
歐文茫然地凝視著生命石。
	「我們殺了他，」歐文說道，語氣裡滿是痛楚的傷懷。「他是來王國警告我們的，我們卻殺了他。」
	「別鬧脾氣，歐文。現在不是耍性子的時候。」
	歐文震驚地瞪著帕格，張口想反駁，卻發現自己找不出恰當的話語。他一氣之下轉身欲走，卻感覺到大法師的手按上了他的肩頭。
	「等等，」帕格說道，語氣比先前柔和了許多。他迎上男孩滿懷怨恨的目光，示意他留下。「你必須明白。戈拉斯碰到那把劍的那一刻，就已經死了。若我們再多猶豫片刻，他跟迪勒肯都會死，而一股難以言喻的邪惡也將肆虐我們的世界。當迪勒肯開始變化時，你也看見了，瓦爾赫魯正試圖將他們塑造成自己能夠使用的形體。你還記得我們在提米里安亞見過的可怕浩劫嗎？跟活在他們統治之下相比，那簡直是天堂。我告訴你這些，是因為你如今擁有的知識與能力，伴隨著沉重的責任。若你繼續走下去，總有一天，你得做出比這更艱難的決定。你必須學會三思而後行，但無論對錯，都不要為自己的決定後悔。否則，你會漸漸變得，什麼決定都不敢做了。」
	「但我要怎麼知道哪個決定才是對的？」歐文問道。「我要如何肯定？」
	帕格輕輕捏了捏他的肩膀。「你得活到一把年紀才會懂，而我還沒老到能給你答案。我只知道，黑袍馬克羅斯曾經告訴過我一句話：好好栽培身邊的人，讓他們變得強大，但也要讓他們學會愛人與慷慨。這些特質，我在你身上都看見了。」�

entries.source: Locklear and Owyn escort Gorath to Krondor. Finding the gates jammed, they are forced to enter the palace through the royal sewers.�
entries.translation: 洛克利爾與歐文護送戈拉斯前往克朗多。發現城門受阻後，他們被迫從王家下水道潛入王宮。�

entries.source: James and Gorath meet Owyn in the sewers under Krondor and the trio travels to Romney to rendezvous with a detachment of King Lyam's troops at the Black Sheep tavern.�
entries.translation: 詹姆士與戈拉斯在克朗多的地底下水道與歐文會合，三人一同前往羅姆尼，與萊亞姆王麾下的一支部隊在黑羊酒館會面。�

entries.source: James, Owyn, and Gorath solve the mystery of the spyglass and the spider. Following a tangled web of clues they penetrate the Nighthawk's headquarters and discover a chest that should hold the evidence they need to convince Arutha of the impending moredhel attack.�
entries.translation: 詹姆士、歐文與戈拉斯解開了望遠鏡與蜘蛛之謎。循著錯綜複雜的線索，他們潛入夜鷹會的總部，發現了一個箱子，裡頭理應藏有能說服亞魯莎、證實莫瑞德人即將來襲的證據。�

entries.source: Heading south to deliver an important note to prince Arutha, Gorath and Owyn are captured by the moredhel and imprisoned in the dungeons at Sar-Sargoth. They manage to escape and finally fight their way to the Inclindel Pass where they are given an escort to Arutha's camp outside the Dimwood forest.�
entries.translation: 戈拉斯與歐文南下，欲將一份重要密函送交亞魯莎王子，途中卻被莫瑞德人擒獲，囚禁於薩薩戈斯的地牢。兩人設法脫逃，一路奮戰至因克林德爾山口，隨後獲派護送至幽暗林外亞魯莎的營地。�

entries.source: James, Locklear, and Patrus help Duke Martin prepare for the moredhel siege on Northwarden.�
entries.translation: 詹姆士、洛克利爾與派特魯斯協助馬丁公爵，備戰莫瑞德人對北衛城的圍攻。�

entries.source: Stunned by the sudden disappearance of Pug and Gamina, Owyn and Gorath search desperately for the Book of Macros...their only clue. The quest takes them through the mines of the Mac Mordain to the tree top city of Elvandar.�
entries.translation: 帕格與蓋米娜突然失蹤，令歐文與戈拉斯震驚不已，兩人拼命尋找『馬克羅斯之書』——他們唯一的線索。這趟旅程帶著他們穿越麥克莫丹的礦坑，一路來到樹頂之城艾爾凡達。�

entries.source: Realizing the moredhel attacks at Northwarden and Highcastle were part of a clever ruse to pull his forces into defensive positions along the northern border and away from Sethanon -- Delekhan and Makala's òtrue objective -- Arutha sends James, Locklear, and Patrus to the Dimwood to find and òdestroy the rift machine.�
entries.translation: 亞魯莎意識到，莫瑞德人對北衛城與高堡的攻勢，不過是一場精心設計的騙局，目的是誘使他將兵力集中防守北疆，遠離賽瑟儂——那才是迪勒肯與馬卡拉ò真正的目標——於是他派遣詹姆士、洛克利爾與派特魯斯前往幽暗林，尋找並ò摧毀那台裂界機。�

entries.source: Having used the Book of Macros to follow Pug to an alien world nearly devoid of magic, Owyn and Gorath finally locate the powerless magician. Together, they are able to find Pug's daughter Gamina...trapped in a crystal cage.�
entries.translation: 歐文與戈拉斯憑藉『馬克羅斯之書』，一路追隨帕格來到一個近乎沒有法術的異世界，終於找到了失去力量的大法師。兩人合力，找到了帕格的女兒蓋米娜……她正被困在一座水晶牢籠之中。�

entries.source: Hoping to prevent Makala from reaching the Lifestone before them, Pug, Owyn, and Gorath discover that the cavern containing the magical device has been sealed by a group of Tsurani spellcasters known as óThe óSix. After finding and killing the last of these magicians, they are shocked to find Makala already in the cavern. Pug and Owyn engage the Tsurani Great One in a spectacular magic battle and, finally, defeat him.�
entries.translation: 為了搶在馬卡拉之前抵達生命石，帕格、歐文與戈拉斯發現，藏有那件法器的洞穴，已被一群自稱『ó六ó賢者』的圖蘭尼施法者封印。他們找出並擊殺了最後一名法師後，卻震驚地發現馬卡拉早已身在洞穴之中。帕格與歐文與這位圖蘭尼大賢者展開一場精彩絕倫的法術大戰，終於將他擊敗。�
